quiz.question: First off, violins belong to the family of orchestral instruments known as...?
quiz.question_short: Violins belong to the family of orchestral instruments known as...?

quiz.question: Second, violin bows are made from the hair of...?
quiz.question_short: Violin bows are made from the hair of...?

quiz.question: Last but not least, people who make and repair violins are referred to as...?

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you think Tom and Kim should get together?
Do you have a date for your Valentine's Day dance?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Anyway, you were saying something about a drive, dinner, and a movie?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Er... I was just thinking that you've seemed a little down since your break up, and we could do something fun to cheer you up...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: As, you know... Er... `Friends...`
nodes.text_bbcode: As, you know... Er... [color=#e23b3b][i]Friends...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, Tom, that's really sweet!
Kim pulls Tom into a hug.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're the best friend ever! I'd love to go!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll be ready in a sec. I just need to grab my coat from the back room.
Kim disappears deeper into the bakery...
In a flash, Tom trashes the bouquet of flowers in a nearby waste bin and whips out his cell phone!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeeves! Abort! ABORT! `ABORT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Jeeves! Abort! ABORT! [color=#e23b3b][i]ABORT![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Ah, Master Tom, I presume by your high-pitched, panicked tone that all has gone according to plan.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?! `No!!!` It's going totally off the rails!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! [color=#e23b3b][i]No!!![/i][/color] It's going totally off the rails!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're still doing the date, only now Kim thinks we're just hanging out as friends.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I see. How unfortunate...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: If only someone close to you had suggested you approach her as a friend `before` making such elaborately romantic plans...
nodes.text_bbcode: If only someone close to you had suggested you approach her as a friend [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] making such elaborately romantic plans...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know, right? What gives, Jeevesy? You're `supposed` to be looking out for me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, right? What gives, Jeevesy? You're [color=#e23b3b][i]supposed[/i][/color] to be looking out for me.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Wait, but... I was the...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Oh, nevermind...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Egregious oversights notwithstanding, sir, might I suggest that your course is clear...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: If you truly do like this girl, you must endeavor to be there for her in whatever capacity she requires.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And if all Kim needs is a friend, then you must be that friend.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, so you're saying I should still do all the `events` I had planned for the date, but we should do them as friends instead...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so you're saying I should still do all the [color=#e23b3b][i]events[/i][/color] I had planned for the date, but we should do them as friends instead...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Exactly, sir!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But what happens if she figures out I'd intended to ask her out?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: It must not happen, sir! It must not!
Kim strides back into the kitchen...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm ready, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Er, gotta go!
Tom hangs up his cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, who were you just talking to?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, my butler...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was just checking to make sure everything's perfect for our da... `Day` of hanging out!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was just checking to make sure everything's perfect for our da... [color=#e23b3b][i]Day[/i][/color] of hanging out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh... Let's get started!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You do...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, it makes total sense. I mean, you're smart, you're cute, you can cook...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The only thing better would be if you had a servant to do that last part for you!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks, Tom... I think.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You don't...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course not... I mean, who would ask `you` to the dance?
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course not... I mean, who would ask [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If a guy wanted to get his toes crushed by something that smelled like cinnamon, he'd slap a corsage on a churro cart!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow. Tom, that's...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And even if he did ask you out, what would you two do afterwards? Go back to your place and watch a bunch of reality TV shows about baking sweets?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Spoiler alert: somebody makes a cupcake, and it's delicious!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But... But Tom, I actually do like those shows...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Right. Uh, I mean, I do too. I was just saying what those other guys think. Not me...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Right...
He hides the bouquet of sunflowers behind his back.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: But that has nothing to do with what I said! I suggested that you...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aw, you worry too much, Jeevesy. This is going to go flawlessly! Trust me!
Tom bolts out the door. Jeeves sighs and mutters to himself...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I always do trust you, sir...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And sadly, I'm all too often disappointed.
A short while later, Tom bursts through the bakery door!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They'll let Kim know I'm interested in a wild, heated romance!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They'll let Kim know I think she's a fragile, delicate beauty!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They'll let Kim know I think she's a sturdy, reliable companion!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And that's why I'm going to take Kim on the most amazing date ever!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We'll start with a romantic drive along the coastal highway at sunset...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then we'll eat at Armondo's, the romantic-est and most exclusive-est restaurant in all of Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And for the grand finale, I'll buy out all the tickets at a movie, so we can be alone when we finally make sweet `smoochus uninterruptus...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And for the grand finale, I'll buy out all the tickets at a movie, so we can be alone when we finally make sweet [color=#e23b3b][i]smoochus uninterruptus...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tom flips open his laptop and makes the reservations...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And `done!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]done![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: All that's left now is to go ask Kim out!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Right now?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom, I object! A relationship with Kim is not some problem to be solved by throwing money at it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, and why not? I mean, it totally worked fine with all the other girls I've dated...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You remember Krystyn, Ambyr, and Tamaryn, right? Those girls totally loved going shopping with me!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Yes, sir. I do remember them. You called them the 'Y-girls'...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: When I asked you why on earth you'd date such vacuous creatures, you'd always reply...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Y` not? Heh... Hilarious!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Y[/i][/color] not? Heh... Hilarious!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: But I ask you, Master Tom, did you ever, even for the slightest moment, feel for those girls the way you feel for Kim?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...No, I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Then perhaps you should consider pursuing Kim in a different and more respectful manner.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're right...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I very much applaud your intent, sir. It demonstrates growing emotional maturity...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, duh... I'm awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: However, there is the small matter of timing...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Kim just ended one relationship. Are you sure you want to ask her to dive right into another one?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're probably right, Jeeves, but I've wanted Kim for a long time now, and I just can't wait any longer...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Sir, I didn't mean your literal dreams. I meant the thing you've always wanted!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They invented a book you can drink?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No, not that either!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then what is it, man?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom, I'm trying to tell you. Your young crush, Ms. Kim, has just changed her `Pop-Ups` relationship status to 'single'...
nodes.text_bbcode: Master Tom, I'm trying to tell you. Your young crush, Ms. Kim, has just changed her [color=#e23b3b][i]Pop-Ups[/i][/color] relationship status to 'single'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So wait, you're telling me that Kim's finally had her fill of Phil?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: `Yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thank the almighty dollar! Why didn't you say so in the first place?! This is fabulous news!
Tom sweeps aside nefarious schemes entitled 'Operation: Chill Phil' and whips out new, gold-embossed blueprints entitled 'My Rich Date with Kim'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, now all I need to do is ask Kim out by planning something really...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...Underwear?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...Falling?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...Spider monkeys?!

nodes.title: The Kim-Provised First Date
nodes.subtitle: Can Tom help Kim get over Phil?

nodes.text: In an apartment on the Spartan Academy side of Centerscore...
Jeeves the Butler toils early into the morning, compulsively clicking the 'refresh' button on the computer's web browser...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Refresh... Refresh... Refresh...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Refr... Great Caesar's slave! Sir, it's finally happened!
Jeeves leaps up from the computer desk...
...And bursts into the bedroom of Tom Prince!
Inside, Tom pours studiously over blueprints and ominous, black-and-white photographs of Phil going about his day...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom! What you've always dreamt of has finally come true!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, you mean, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Kim, your relationship with Phil ran its course...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean it hurts any less to see it end...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Right now, what you need to do is focus on the positive things in your life!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Your family, your school, your bakery, your small business loan with generous terms provided by Prince Financial Services...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're right! Those are all good things, and I am grateful for them.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And I'm also grateful for you, Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Me?! Really?! I mean, why?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Because you've been a great friend to me these past few months.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I mean, I `do` try...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I mean, I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] try...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Heh... 'Try' being the operative word...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But seriously, though... Me and Tom Prince? Who would've guessed we'd ever be hanging out?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly? I guess, `I` did... Or I hoped...
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly? I guess, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] did... Or I hoped...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Err, I mean, because I need to make sure that small business loan is repaid in full. I have a fiduciary duty to my shareholders, you know!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anyway, here we are!

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Oh no... I've forgotten everything!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay... To do this, I'll need to quickly remember everything I've ever known about violins!

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: First off, violins belong to the family of orchestral instruments known as...?

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Second, violin bows are made from the hair of...?

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Last but not least, people who make and repair violins are referred to as...?

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Good answer!
Tom approaches the first person in line and flashes a thick wad of cash!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, hey! You there!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Well well, Tom Prince. I suppose you want a picture with me in my awesome, bioluminescent 'Prawn Legacy' costume?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, actually, I... My friend and I really want to see this movie... Can you help?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Wait. You... You want to `buy my ticket?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait. You... You want to [color=#e23b3b][i]buy my ticket?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean... If you'd be willing to sell it...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Sell it?! I've been camping in front of this theater for seventeen days just to make sure that I was first in line to see this movie!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: I haven't slept! I've only used the bathroom twice!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Do you seriously believe I would sell you my tickets?! This movie is my whole life!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, when you put it that way...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'll just walk away... Slowly...
Tom steps back to Kim. He looks forlorn...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sorry, Kim. I tried, but I guess we're out of luck...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's okay, Tom. Let's just head home.
Tom approaches the ticket taker, and he slaps a thick wad of cash down on the counter!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! I know this movie is sold out, but my friend and I really want to see it... Can you help us out?
Quick as a flash, the ticket taker scoops up the money!

nodes.speaker: Ticket Taker
nodes.text: Heh... Well, now that you mention it, I do have a couple of `press passes` that never got picked up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh... Well, now that you mention it, I do have a couple of [color=#e23b3b][i]press passes[/i][/color] that never got picked up...

nodes.speaker: Ticket Taker
nodes.text: Here you are, Kid! Go right in!
Tom and Kim enter the theater and sit down in the roped-off press area!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, Tom! These seats are fantastic! I was worried we wouldn't get in when I saw that the show was sold out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh... Not a problem when you roll with Tom Prince.
As Tom crosses to the ticket booth, the electronic display begins to flash the words 'SOLD OUT'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh no! Sold out?! The only way in now is to bribe someone.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'll need to talk to...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: As a joke...?! Are you saying that my hurt feelings are a source of amusement to you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, I just... If we can't laugh at ourselves, who can we laugh at?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom! That's the dumbest thing I've ever heard!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sorry, Kim... I'll go try to get us tickets for 'Prawn Legacy'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The thing is, you act tough all the time, but I know you've got a sweet spot for chick flicks!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Usually, I mean... Anyway, I was hoping that seeing a romantic movie might cheer you up.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Aw, it's true, Tom. I do like romantic comedies. Most of the time. Thanks for thinking of me...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But maybe this one time, we should see something different.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh... Okay. I'll go try to get us tickets for 'Prawn Legacy'.
Tom races to the door and intercepts the violinist as he enters the restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Unkempt hair... Artsy black shirt... Cheap shoes...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You look like a musician!

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: For shizzle, dawg. I'm the violinist, and those three guys are the rest of the string quartet.
The cellist, bassist, and violist nod.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good! Now listen, I'm the guy who hired you, and I don't want you to play any more...
Tom pulls out his wallet and thumbs out a few bills.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So how much will it cost for you to leave and never come back? One hundred? Two hundred?

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Listen, shrimp. Do you think we became musicians for the `money?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, shrimp. Do you think we became musicians for the [color=#e23b3b][i]money?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, I hope not... I mean, if that was your goal, you'd be better off with an organ grinder and a pet monkey.

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Grr... My point is we became musicians because of all the hotties we meet when whenever we play!

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: But if we don't play, we don't meet hotties...

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Ipso focoso, we `do` play! Heh... And speaking of which...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ipso focoso, we [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] play! Heh... And speaking of which...

nodes.text: The violinist leads the rest of the string quartet to the table Kim is sitting at...

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Hello. You look like the type of girl who recently changed her Pop-Ups status to 'single'...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, I do?

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Absolutely! We musicians have a sixth sense about girls in need of a steamy, romantic fling...
Before Kim can reply, Tom seizes Kim by the hand and yanks her up from the table!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good! Now listen, I'm the guy who hired you, and there's been a change of plans...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I want to play with you, guys!

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: What?! Really?! I mean, cool! Us musician-types are always ready to jam anytime, anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Great! Now I'll just need to borrow a violin...

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Whoa now... It isn't that easy! I'm totally cool to let you jam with us...

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: But if I'm going to let you borrow a violin, you'll to have to prove to me that you know the basics.

nodes.speaker: Violinist
nodes.text: Let me ask you a few questions...
Tom's cell phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sorry, Kim, but I need to take this.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No problem.
Tom slips away from the table and answers his phone.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeeves! What are you doing? I told you not to bother me!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I know, sir, and ordinarily, I wouldn't, but...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeeves, what's gone wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom, it's the string quartet you ordered to serenade Kim during dinner!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I tried to cancel, but they wouldn't take no for an answer!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: They'll be at the restaurant any second now!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, they're not here yet, which means it's not too late. I can still...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Appetizers...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure! They're big, they're tasty, and they're cheap, too...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We can order two or three, and we'll have more than enough to eat!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't think of that. Great!
The host escorts Tom and Kim to their table and takes their orders...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mmm! Tom, these appetizers are delicious!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And I don't know about you, but I love eating meals where food gets shared...
The host escorts Tom and Kim to a candle-lit table near a large bay window...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: See? The view `is` pretty cool, right? And you can even hear the ocean rumbling!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? The view [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] pretty cool, right? And you can even hear the ocean rumbling!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Actually, that's my stomach... And I'm not sure that eating sprigs of parsley counts as 'dinner'...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure! This restaurant is built into the side of a cliff overlooking the ocean...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We'll be able to see big waves crashing ashore from the comfort of our table!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You mean, the table that I'll be sitting at... With no food on it...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know you're worried, but I'm sure we can find something on the menu we can both afford...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I hope so...
The host escorts Tom and Kim to a candle-lit table near a large bay window...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: See? The view `is` pretty cool, right? And you can even hear the ocean rumbling!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? The view [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] pretty cool, right? And you can even hear the ocean rumbling!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Actually, that's my stomach... And I'm not sure that eating sprigs of parsley counts as 'dinner'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why do you even care what that guy says? Phil's a total jerk!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What?! No, he isn't!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean, he can be a little dense, and our relationship had some problems, but Phil's not a terrible person!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I really like Phil!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And... Sniffle... And even though I know we needed to break up, I still miss him, and that's why I'm sad now.
Kim looks out the passenger side window and sobs quietly...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh oh... I definitely said the wrong thing. Hopefully, a nice dinner will be enough to cheer Kim up...
Tom and Kim continue their long, lazy drive along the coast...
Kim tells Tom about her break up with Phil...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And then Phil came into the bakery, and he said...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It seems like we've just been getting more and more distant. And I don't know what we have in common anymore...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know he was right about our relationship, but... I'm still sad. Am I crazy?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, Kim is really opening up to me here... I need to say the right things to cheer her up...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The thing is I made the dinner reservations for an hour from now, but we're way ahead of schedule, so...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So you're saying that we're driving slowly because you planned badly?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That... Would... Be... Correct...?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I guess it's okay...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But if I'd known we were ahead of schedule, I would've whipped up a few more batches of cookies at the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: After Mallika and I broke up, I drove up and down this highway for hours...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Break up? But you and Mallika never actually dated...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Right, but... It `felt` like a break up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Right, but... It [color=#e23b3b][i]felt[/i][/color] like a break up...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The important thing is that it felt good to clear my mind of everything upsetting and just drive for a while.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So you're saying it was `car`thartic...? I like that!
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're saying it was [color=#3b78e2][i]car[/i][/color]thartic...? I like that!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh... I never really thought about it in those terms...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But yeah, I guess it was!
Tom steers his convertible onto the Gold Highway, the western-most toll highway in America. To one side, Tom and Kim view bronze-colored steppes...
To the other, they see a spectacular orange sunset, dripping behind the cool, blue waters of the Pacific...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, that view is amazing! And you're actually driving! Honestly, I wasn't sure you knew how.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I guess there's a lot you don't know about me, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Huh... Guess so.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anyway, I thought you'd like the view...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I mean, it's not like Fiji or Cancun, but it's a pretty good sunset for the continental United States...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anyway, the restaurant is a few miles north of here, but in the meantime, I thought we could drive nice and slow...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Nice and slow...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What am I doing?! This is way too much like a date! I need to cover! I should mention...
Tom looks down to see dozens of spider monkeys creeping across his body!

nodes.speaker: Spider Monkey
